name: How long does it typically take to install stone stairs?
description: Installation time for stone stairs typically ranges from 1-4 weeks, depending on complexity, number of steps, stone type, and site conditions.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install stone stairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stone stair installation varies significantly based on the project's complexity, the number of steps, the type of stone, and site conditions. A straightforward, small set of steps might take 1-2 weeks. Larger, more intricate designs, or those involving significant site preparation like excavation and foundation work, could extend to 3-4 weeks or more. Factors such as weather conditions and the need for custom cuts can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for stone stairs typically ranges from 1-4 weeks, depending on complexity, number of steps, stone type, and site conditions.
